mentions.name: vllm-on-eks
mentions.description: This project runs vLLM on a Kubernetes cluster (EKS) for LLM inference and includes a gateway that maintains a sub-2-second time-to-first-token SLO. Built as a hands-on learning effort around inference, it emphasizes in-flight requests as a key metric (each engine streaming tokens for ~70 concurrent requests at a time).
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm learning about inference by running vLLM on a k8s cluster (EKS), building a gateway to keep a <2s TTFT SLO.
